info.title: Speckle Preview Service API
info.description: Preview images and videos of Speckle projects, models, versions, and objects. The paths keep the server's original names: `streamId` is the project id, `branchName` the model name, and `commitId` the version id.

servers.description: Self-hosted instance (replace with your server URL)

bearerAuth.description: Personal access token with the `streams:read` scope. Only needed for private projects.

get.description: The preview of the project's newest version on any model. Public projects need no token; otherwise send a token with read access to the project. On Speckle Cloud and Speckle Enterprise Server, a token restricted to particular models or versions must also cover the version the preview comes from. The response is an image even when there is nothing to show: a project, model or version without a preview gets a placeholder PNG, and the first request for an object without a preview queues its render. While a render is queued, running, or failed, the placeholder carries `X-Preview-Error: true` and is not cached. Append `/{angle}` to pick another image of the same preview; see the endpoint's angle variant. Add `?postprocess=og` for a 1200×627 Open Graph image with the project name over the preview.

parameters.name: streamId
parameters.description: The project id.

parameters.name: postprocess
parameters.description: `og` returns a 1200×627 Open Graph image with the project name over the preview.

200.description: The preview: a PNG, or a WebM video for the `spin` key. A placeholder PNG when there is no preview yet.

X-Preview-Error.description: `true` when the body is a placeholder.

X-Preview-Error-Code.description: `PREVIEW_NOT_FOUND` (no finished render yet) or `ANGLE_NOT_FOUND` (the preview has no such key).

401.description: No valid token for a non-public project. Speckle Cloud and Enterprise Server answer with this status and a placeholder image; the open-source server answers 200 with an error image.

403.description: The token cannot read the project, or is restricted to other models or versions.

404.description: No such project. On Speckle Cloud and Enterprise Server, also an archived project or a missing preview file.

get.summary: Get a Project's Latest Preview at an Angle

parameters.name: angle
